expression_primary.vectors: experimentally observed plate-averaged treated minus matched-DMSO natural log1p(TPM)
expression_primary.contexts: each drug and cell line separately
expression_primary.condition_program: frozen signed top-500 Bridge or DE module per contrast
expression_primary.statistic: negative linear-rank-weighted cosine on genes observed in both resources; positive means opposition
expression_primary.null: competitive empirical rank within the 372 drugs in the same cell line and frozen condition contrast
expression_primary.multiple_testing: BH within condition contrast x method x cell line
expression_primary.descriptive_candidate: positive score, empirical p <= 0.05 in both GSE264130 cell lines
expression_primary.cross_study_candidate: positive score and empirical p <= 0.10 in both cell lines for every one of the three condition datasets

latent_primary.input: observed GSE264130 natural log1p(TPM), zero-filled to canonical 15,165-gene order
latent_primary.encoder: frozen r7hnr92k checkpoint, mean final contextual token layer
latent_primary.drug_delta: mean over two plate-level treated embedding minus matched six-DMSO-well embedding centroid
latent_primary.statistic: cosine; negative means opposition; reported reversal is negative cosine
latent_primary.null: competitive empirical rank within the 372 drugs in the same cell line and contrast
latent_primary.multiple_testing: BH within condition contrast x cell line

cell_consensus: never average cell lines before individual scoring; classify both/one/mixed/reinforcement/insufficient
anti_tuning: resource, signatures, statistics, nulls and thresholds frozen before scoring observed drug outcomes
